exposure: three groups based on COS protocol: Group A (recombinant FSH/highly purified urinary menotropins), Group B (corifollitropin alfa), Group C (rFSH/rLH)
outcome: follicular fluid biomarker levels (leptin, VEGF, MMPs, NO2-/NO3-)
cohort: Women with poor ovarian response undergoing IVF
finding: Significant variations in follicular fluid biomarker concentrations were observed between different controlled ovarian stimulation protocols, suggesting potential for these biomarkers as non-invasive predictors of egg quality.
